description: Approvers are people who decide held actions. List active and revoked dedicated approvers with ids, names and creation times; never returns keys or hashes. Team members with the approver role are a separate list. Requires the project owner key or an active member key. Use gate_create_approver to issue a key, gate_revoke_approver to revoke one, or gate_manage_members to inspect team roles.

admin_key.description: The project owner key (ga_...) or an active member key (gm_...). Never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_list_approvers
title: List approver keys
